named_events.loss_description: The largest loss ($10m net), Tullow Oil, was the result of a damaged oil and gas floating production storage and offloading (FPSO) vessel and impacted the Marine XL and Energy classes.
Significant claims in the year were limited to Marine XL's majority share of the Syndicate's largest loss, Tullow Oil, and the Canadian Wildfires in Property XL.
It was another good year for the Terrorism account which recorded solid profits of $11.2m (2015: $9.4m profit) with the only loss of any significance relating to the Brussels airport attack.

data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development triangle, the Syndicate recorded an adverse prior-year development of approximately $57.5m (12.0% of opening gross claims outstanding), i.e. a strengthening of reserves. The public narrative records a net deterioration of $7.197m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (after reinsurance). Contributing factors cited include large losses (notably the Tullow Oil FPSO loss), natural catastrophe activity (Canadian wildfires) and adverse back-year development in Professional Indemnity, together with IBNR movements.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a deterioration of ($7,197,000) in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2015: release $6,284,000).
The deterioration comprises net claims including the change in claims incurred but not reported ('IBNR').
back-year claims in Professional Indemnity (PI) contributed to an overall Specialty loss.
Significant claims in the year were limited to Marine XL's majority share of the Syndicate's largest loss, Tullow Oil, and the Canadian Wildfires in Property XL.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development (cumulative incurred) triangle because no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' line was present. The report provides a net deterioration figure ($7.197m) - the gross movement derived from the triangle is materially larger (approx $57.5m), indicating substantial reinsurance recoveries. All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD) though field names include '_gbp_m' per the required schema. Confidence scores reflect whether values were directly stated (1.0), calculated from provided tables (0.8), or inferred.
